scope: authored local encrypted-backup and checkpoint controls only

contract.checkpoint: separate immutable file plus out-of-band SHA
contract.snapshot: SQLite backup API under ledger lock; authenticated witness and key in ciphertext
contract.restore: fresh private output; authenticated validation before publication; no automatic activation
contract.ongoing_access: CheckpointedWebLedger verifies minimum prefix and clock on every operation

limits: Local logical separation; no remote WORM or physical-host HA.
Latest checkpoint and expected hashes must be protected outside the rollback domain.
Events after the last checkpoint are outside its rollback guarantee.
Demonstration recovery key is ephemeral and not persisted. Real key custody and remote storage are operational prerequisites.
No real IdP/PDP/sensor collection, new independent performance evaluation or production incident integration.
